name: blocks-editor-web
description: Visual Blockly editor for MakeCode .blocks files. Runs in vscode.dev and co-edits over Live Share.

commands.title: Blocks: Open Active File as XML Text
Blocks: Open Active File in Blocks Editor

blocksEditor.writeDebounceMs.description: How long to wait after the last block change before writing it to the file. Lower means collaborators see your changes sooner, at the cost of more document revisions.

enumDescriptions: MakeCode's own renderer, ported from pxt. Blocks get the exact geometry the Arcade editor draws.
Blockly’s rounded renderer, which pxt’s is derived from.
Embed the real MakeCode Arcade editor. Every block, the image and tilemap editors and the simulator are the genuine ones. Requires access to arcade.makecode.com.
Use the built-in Blockly editor. Works with no network access, and merges simultaneous edits more finely, but does not include MakeCode’s tilemap, melody or grid editors.
blocksEditor.engine.description: Which editor to draw .blocks files with.

enumDescriptions: A credentialless iframe. Chrome added this exactly so a page with Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp (which vscode.dev sets) can embed cross-origin content that does not assert COEP itself. The frame gets no cookies and fresh storage, which costs nothing here because the project is supplied over the controller protocol.
A standard iframe. Works in desktop VS Code; refused on vscode.dev, where require-corp applies.
blocksEditor.embedElement.description: Which element embeds the MakeCode editor. "credentialless" is the one that works under vscode.dev’s embedder policy.

blocksEditor.remoteApplyDelayMs.description: How long you must be idle before someone else's change is applied. Applying one reloads the editor, so a short delay keeps it from interrupting you mid-drag. If you are not editing, changes appear immediately regardless. Lower is more live; 0 applies them the moment they arrive.
